system.description:
The character is restricted to a specific physical area and cannot leave it.
Rank 1: Confined to a large area (100 km radius), such single kingdom, country, or large city
Rank 2: Confined to a moderate area (1 km radius), such small town or large, multi-structure complex
Rank 3: Confined to a small area (100 m radius), such tiny village or single building
